message: No detected input validation: The code loads numpy arrays and labels directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape validation, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths via np.load without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; no remote source fetching is present in this code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code filters labels by minimum frequency (min_impression_num) but performs no distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection to identify flipped labels.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering applied to training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code initializes models from scratch and comments reference loading pretrained weights ('#学習済みモデルのパラメータを使用') but no actual weight loading code is visible, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision anywhere in the provided snippets.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise injection mechanism is used in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are present in the code; the evaluation only computes FID and mAP scores.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other metric manipulation protections; the evaluation uses the same data pipeline without isolation controls.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the models; inputs are used directly from numpy loads and random tensors without any guards.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are consumed directly (e.g., for loss computation and label generation) without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or calibrated threshold enforcement.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a GAN-based image generation pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
